releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Hypergamous Tree Chopping Simulator 3 - Update 1.1.0

- Added Open 3 to every case, with three simultaneous reels and rewards sent to the locker or coop.
- Added a global leaderboard for score, rarest axe, logs chopped, rebirths, and chickens.
- Players claim a globally unique username on first launch; the username is saved in the existing save file. Returning players can keep playing offline during service interruptions.
- Removed Premium Feed; chickens never need to be fed.
- Added Brood Catalyst at Rebirth 10, Sap Resonance at Rebirth 20, and Prestige Prism at Prestige 1.
- Progression now ends at 50 total rebirths, with more shard rewards and rarer case odds.
- Added Case Compass, Pity Sigil, and Brood Charm shard relics.
- Added Prestige 1/3/5 milestone rewards, hard pity for long case streaks, and Recent Discoveries.
- Added the Prestige Vault: one Prestige Token per prestige, Ancient-plus rewards only, and Open 3 support.
- Each prestige adds 10% forest output and a modest relative case-luck boost focused on Ancient and higher tiers.
- Mutated Axe Case now contains only axes; Mutated Flock Case contains only chickens.
- Added THE Axe Skin with Hypergamous rarity: exactly 0.000001% chance (1 in 100,000,000) from the Axe Skin Case.
